column1: # A FAIL fails the weekly scan; anything not listed is a warning in the report.

column3: (Every page refuses to be framed by other sites.)
(Every response carries a Permissions-Policy that turns off the browser features WhatBuild never uses.)
(The pinned ZAP image is the current release. When this fails, pin the new one in security.yml, by tag and digest.)
(Every response says Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin and Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: credentialless; app pages also say Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin.)
(Errors never show stack traces or internals.)

(Every page's policy defines frame-ancestors, form-action and base-uri, and server tests hold it. The rule also reports the app's style-src 'unsafe-inline', which previews of uploaded HTML pages use, so it warns rather than fails.)

(Hashed assets are cached for a year by design, and the shell and the site's files hold nothing personal; responses that carry people's material, identity or credentials say no-store, and server tests hold it.)
(Words such as "admin" and "select" in the minified bundle's strings and code, which the rule takes for comments; the source, comments and all, is public.)
(Informational: the app is a single-page application, which the baseline's spider does not crawl.)
(Strict-Transport-Security: the scan runs over plain HTTP on localhost; the server sends it when its public URL is https.)
(Secure cookies: the scan runs over plain HTTP on localhost.)
